item.title: How you can save as prescription costs rise
item.description: At the start of 2026, manufacturers raised prices on over 300 brand-name drugs, including antivirals, vaccines and medications treating diabetes and migraines, just to name a few.

item.title: UPDATE: Inmate who walked away from Lincoln County prison camp back in custody
item.description: Authorities are looking for a 39-year-old man who walked away from a prison camp in Lincoln County and could be headed for Las Vegas.

item.title: Demolition date set for Eastside Cannery, which never reopened following COVID
item.description: The long-closed Eastside Cannery casino on the Boulder Strip, which closed during the COVID-19 pandemic and never reopened, now has an official demolition date set.

item.title: Could Tool play at Las Vegas' Sphere in 2027? Their drummer says 'maybe'
item.description: Could rock band Tool be one of the next acts to perform at Sphere in Las Vegas? Drummer Danny Carey says the band is in talks to take the stage in 2027.

item.title: Mother, daughter killed in apparent murder-suicide at hotel near Las Vegas Strip
item.description: A mother and daughter were killed in an apparent murder-suicide at the Rio Hotel and Casino near the Las Vegas Strip, according to Las Vegas Metro police.

item.title: How much rain could Las Vegas get this week?
item.description: Strong winds rolled into the Las Vegas valley on Monday, bringing unsettled weather changes for the week that include rain and mountain snow.

item.title: Kubiak fills vacancies on Las Vegas Raiders coaching staff
item.description: In the seven days since the Klint Kubiak was named Las Vegas Raiders head coach, he has filled several vacancies on his coaching staff.

item.title: Las Vegas woman admits marijuana use before hit-and-run that killed man, 80, on scooter, prosecutors say
item.description: A Las Vegas driver accused of hitting and killing an 80-year-old man on a mobility scooter told police she consumed marijuana before the crash, according to prosecutors.

item.title: Records show years-long custody battle before shooting that left mother, 11-year-old dead at Las Vegas hotel
item.description: Friends and teammates honored 11-year-old Addi Smith of Utah after police said she was shot and killed by her mother in an apparent murder-suicide inside their Las Vegas hotel room near the Strip. Documents obtained by 8 News Now show a years-long custody battle preceded the deadly shooting.
